notes: SYNTHETIC – NOT ADIC DATA: every ADIC figure in the design comes from the synthetic book or proxies (ARCHITECTURE header; §9.5).
Layered composite (ADR-01): PD leads engines and ledger, PA the optimizer and duals, PB lab integrity, PC the decision room; PE ideas enter as grafts (§0.3).

One ledger kernel, three uses: forward on 10k–50k paths it is P; linearized on a scenario tree it is H (λ, FTP, envelopes); on the canonical stress s*(θ*) it gives T4′ survival and the CFP readiness stage (§3.1).
Dependencies point downward only: L10 never calls an engine directly; it asks the evidence compiler, which asks the evaluator; a layering test enforces this (§3.2).

Edge direction follows the document's diagrams: data, price and evidence edges run from producer to consumer (mostly upward); control edges carry requests, spawns and sign-offs (mostly downward) (§2.4; §3.2).
Deterministic owns numbers: engines L0–L8, meta-controller control flow, gates, tuners, claim renderer and validator, evidence compiler, implied_actions, module F, entropy pooling (§3.3).
Agentic proposes, extracts, argues and narrates (idea bundles, red-team specs, placeholder text, audit verdicts, ViewSpec drafts, seat arguments, minutes, extraction); humans decide (§3.3).
Any probability an AI seat states is labelled 'agent judgment' and never pooled with model outputs; seat numbers come only from implied_actions (§3.3; §0.3 rule 8).
Agents never touch the kernel: typed specs pass the meta-controller's per-state allowlist and the MCP evaluator server; the evaluator prices, counts and gates every call (§3.1; §11.3).

Seal service: salt under the CRO account, commitment at signing, final plane run once in a separate evaluator instance with its own cache; neither MCP server can reach the final plane, the sealed truth or an engine write path (§2.4; §7.2; §11.3).
Offline first: TPA_LLM_MODE = offline (Stub) | replay (a miss fails closed) | live; engines, evaluator, the room's deterministic parts and all tests run with no network (§11.1).

LLM calls use anthropic 1.15 messages.parse with adaptive thinking, strict tool schemas and no sampling parameters; Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are channels behind LLMBackend, not model families (§2.3; §11.2).
At launch no ADIC source is connected: SYN-ADIC-177 and synthetic fixtures stand in, labelled; ISDA SIMM tables feed overlay.simm_like (§2.2).
Laptop isolation relies on separate processes, NTFS ACLs and separate Windows accounts; it is weaker than service accounts and is disclosed (§7.2).

L0 is shared by every layer: contracts freeze in week 2, and every uniform comes from counter-based keyed streams, so common random numbers hold across policies and results do not depend on thread count (§3.4; §3.5).
Owners follow §3.4. Build streams: A data/synth/beliefs/contracts; B world and asset engines; C ledger, core, icm, robust, attrib; D evaluator, lab, agents, overlay, room (§3.4).
Nothing executes trades; execution is by named humans (§0.1; §3.3).

Real Assets (badged): added 18 Oct; research in progress; interim rules (brief §8): group taxonomy as configuration, interim engine, SELL/HOLD/REFI/LEVER action set, open-end redemption queue, asset-level non-recourse debt, oil wrong-way risk.

Real Assets working allocation, pending the user: $18bn (~10%) carved from PE funds ($52bn → $34bn), ~$4bn unfunded; asset-level debt is non-recourse and outside CF facilities but counts in look-through leverage and stress (brief §8.3, §8.6).

Real Assets links: energy and natural resources are wrong-way with the owner's draw through oil; Gulf real estate may follow the fiscal cycle; inflation passes through only partly; touches Private Credit, Capital Solutions, Overlay, Secondaries and CF (brief §8.5, §8.7).

Group taxonomy is configuration: roll-ups, envelopes, FTP charges, attribution, the forecast registry and IC seats are generic over groups; ARCHITECTURE.md names seven groups (§2.1; §9.1) and Real Assets is the eighth (brief §8.1).
